description: Permanent traffic count stations - expressway S6 Poland 2016 is a data set deposited in MOST Wiedzy by its authors Wojciech Kustra, Aleksandra Romanowska. The data includes traffic data from permanent traffic count stations located on the expressway S6 in the Tri-City Agglomeration area in Poland. The data covers the 12 months of 2016. Tricity Bypass Road (expressway S6) is the eastern end segment of the Polish National Road No. Coverage: national (PL); the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
